reviews.review_description: I can't say I've played anything quite like it in VR. The controls were tricky for a minute but then I got the hang of it and now i wish i could jet around IRL. Aerocore is a super fun track, a good mix of skating and flying. It's long enough to be interesting and short enough to learn all the turns and timing of the obstacles. Widowmaker is tough! I'm going to need more practice. It reminds me of Rainbow Road from Mario Kart.

developer_response.body: That's awesome! It's amazing how quickly people master the controls and start breaking records! Thank you for the review!
